items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I know you don't necessarily agree with Rush

ctx.x: I don't think Lester ever recovered, really. You know, because the scene had changed so, and the army had probably demoralized Lester. I never could understand how they could keep a man of Lester's temperament in the army. You know, it probably -- I'm sure emotionally and otherwise it really took its toll on Lester.
Blesh says in his book, and I know you don't necessarily agree with Rush, but that Lester was I believe court-martialed while he was in the army.
